technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Complete sewer system, DN 800, profile 4, SN 10000-20000, according to SIA 190.Trench depth 3 meters. GFRP pipe, ID 770-798 mm, outer diameter 821 mm, wall thickness 11-21 mm, 46-87 kg/m, 1650 kg/m³.

# Included processes
This process models 1 meter of sewer system infrastructure with GFRP pipe, DN 800, SN 10000-20000, profile 4 according to SIA 190. Trench depth: 3 meters. This process includes the production phase (A1–A3), the construction phase/ transport (A4–A5) as well as deconstruction phase (C1), transport phase (C2), treatment/ recycling phase (C3), and final disposal phase (C4) for one meter of sewer system with GFRP pipe.

This process includes the production phase (A1–A3) and the construction phase/ transport (A4–A5) for one linear meter of installed GFRP pipe, including trench excavation and backfilling.; Construction method according to SIA 190, material parameters based on competence centre (cc) Kanalisation, VSA Arbeitsgruppe Materialwahl, transport distances estimated average distances in Switzerland.
